system_description.narrative_title: China's export-driven pivot amid domestic weakness and geopolitical reach
system_description.narrative_summary: China's domestic economy is weakening—sluggish consumption, a deepening investment slump and a jobs squeeze—while state policy and firms push an export-led response across autos, energy and tech. The system behaves as an open one: flows of goods, energy, capital and regulatory influence traverse national borders as China opens new logistics corridors (e.g., Arctic routes), expands refiners and e-truck exports, and leverages state-linked actors to sustain overseas markets. Feedbacks include shipping bottlenecks, global supply-chain dependencies, sanctions and investment retrenchment that simultaneously amplify external influence and domestic vulnerabilities.
system_description.scope: Inside the boundary: China's macro economy (consumption, investment, employment), key industrial sectors (auto manufacturing and exports, refiners/oil trade, renewable power and storage, tech and manufacturing), state policy/regulation (tax, trade controls, security measures), logistics/shipping routes and international trade/energy linkages.
system_description.super_system: Global political-economy: international trade networks, energy markets, sanctions regimes and geopolitical competition among major powers.
adjacent_subsystems: Global auto supply chains and manufacturing

variables.name: Household consumption demand
variables.description: The aggregate level of private household spending on goods and services measured per period.

variables.name: Fixed investment flow
variables.description: The rate of gross capital formation and business investment expenditure flowing into productive assets per period.

variables.name: Employment rate
variables.description: The proportion of the labor force currently employed, reflecting labor market slack and job availability.

variables.name: Manufactured goods export flow
variables.description: The volumetric flow of manufactured and industrial goods shipped to foreign markets per period.

variables.name: Export dependence ratio
variables.description: The share of domestic production (or firm revenue) that is destined for external markets rather than domestic consumption.

variables.name: Industrial capacity utilization
variables.description: The proportion of installed industrial and manufacturing capacity currently in productive use.

variables.name: Refined petroleum export flow
variables.description: The volumetric flow of refined oil and petroleum products exported to external markets per period.

variables.name: Shipping and logistics capacity
variables.description: The available tonnage, route throughput and modal logistics capacity available for moving goods internationally.

variables.name: Logistics congestion level
variables.description: The intensity of bottlenecks, delays and queueing in transport and port networks that slow cargo flows.

variables.name: Global supply-chain integration
variables.description: The degree to which domestic production is embedded in international supplier networks and cross-border input dependencies.

variables.name: Trade and regulatory control intensity
variables.description: The strength and breadth of trade measures, export controls and regulatory interventions affecting cross-border commerce.

variables.name: Perceived sanction/exposure risk
variables.description: Market and actor perception of the likelihood and expected impact of sanctions, restrictions or reputational constraints.

variables.name: State export-support intensity
variables.description: The level of policy, fiscal, financing and non-market support directed toward promoting outbound sales and market access.

variables.name: Net capital flow balance
variables.description: The net cross-border financial flow balance of outbound investment, inbound investment, and portfolio flows per period.

variables.name: Renewable generation & storage capacity
variables.description: The installed capacity of variable renewable power generation and associated energy storage assets available on the grid.

variables.name: Renewable generation curtailment rate
variables.description: The proportion of potential renewable electricity generation that is not delivered to the grid due to congestion or system limits.

catalysts.title: Opening of first regular Arctic cargo route
catalysts.description: Launch of a regular China-Arctic cargo route that bypasses traditional chokepoints, enabling new shipping lanes for exports.
catalysts.rationale: "China Is Opening the First Regular Cargo Route Through the Arctic" (2026-08-18)

catalysts.title: State shippers reroute tankers to avoid chokepoints
catalysts.description: State-controlled tankers operate outside Gulf chokepoints, sustaining alternative shipping patterns for oil and refined products.
catalysts.rationale: "China's state shippers deploy oil tankers outside Gulf, avoid chokepoints" (2026-08-18)

catalysts.title: Ship shortage constrains booming car exports
catalysts.description: Insufficient global shipping capacity for rapidly rising Chinese car exports, creating bottlenecks and delays.
catalysts.rationale: "There Aren’t Enough Ships to Handle China’s Booming Car Exports" (2026-08-16/18)

catalysts.title: Surge in Chinese car exports
catalysts.description: Auto makers expand exports to offset weak domestic demand, raising outbound vehicle shipments across multiple markets.
catalysts.rationale: Geely exports cushion weak domestic demand; multiple headlines on booming car exports (2026-08-16/17/18)

catalysts.title: Easing of curbs and rebound in fuel exports
catalysts.description: Beijing relaxes restrictions on fuel shipments, allowing refined exports to move back toward pre-conflict levels.
catalysts.rationale: "China's fuel exports edge back... as Beijing eases curbs" (2026-08-18)

catalysts.title: Allegations against Hengli and potential probe
catalysts.description: Accusations that a Chinese refiner funded sanctioned Iranian purchases could trigger investigations, trade scrutiny or penalties.
catalysts.rationale: "Hengli accused of funding Iran through sanctioned oil purchases"; "Refinery bankrolling Tehran" (2026-08-16/18)

catalysts.title: Faster rollout of renewable-energy recycling rules
catalysts.description: Accelerated regulations on recycling of renewables and batteries aimed at boosting circular supply chains and ESS lifecycle management.
catalysts.rationale: "China plans faster rollout of renewable-energy recycling rules" and rising ESS shipments (2026-08-16/17)

catalysts.title: Persistent grid limits and clean-power wastage
catalysts.description: Ongoing grid constraints continue to force curtailment of renewable generation, limiting usable clean power.
catalysts.rationale: "China leads wave of clean power wastage as grids globally hit limits" (2026-08-17)

catalysts.title: Global private equity pauses China deals
catalysts.description: Major private-equity players halt or sharply reduce deals in China, choking cross-border investment flows and deal activity.
catalysts.rationale: "Not worth the squeeze': global private equity makes zero deals in China" (2026-08-18)

catalysts.title: Nokia to close mainland China sites by year end
catalysts.description: A major foreign firm announces near-total closure of mainland operations, reducing local investment and jobs.
catalysts.rationale: "Nokia to close almost all sites in mainland China by year end" (2026-08-18)

catalysts.title: Hong Kong 'big bang' tax reforms including trading firms
catalysts.description: Planned Hong Kong tax changes to include trading firms could shift trading activity and capital allocation in the region.
catalysts.rationale: "Hong Kong set to include trading firms in ‘big bang’ tax reforms" (2026-08-17)

catalysts.title: Deepening property and investment slump
catalysts.description: Ongoing weakness in property sales and investment further depresses fixed investment, jobs and household demand.
catalysts.rationale: "China investment slump deepens" and "new home prices stagnant" (2026-08-17)
